scope: Current checksum-locked Southwest Pacific supplements plus the currently reconstructed Hendriks appendix source state. This is not yet a claim that no external reliability source exists anywhere.

available_source_native_information: trait min/max fields in source material
published statement describing a 30-species online-vs-herbarium validation
missing_for_empirical_reliability: paired raw values for the 30-species method validation
repeat-measurement IDs on the predictor scale
replicate counts tied to each mainland mean
within-pair measurement SD or SE on the predictor scale
not_valid_reliability_substitutes: a non-significant online-vs-herbarium group comparison without paired raw measurements
an assumed reliability selected to preserve below-isometry direction
southwest_pacific.source_method_adversary_role: The online-only and geographic-overlap analyses test whether the observed response shape requires herbarium-source pairs; they do not estimate predictor reliability.

available_source_information: reconstructed pair-level source-derived average flower-area values
source citations and appendix pair definitions
missing_for_empirical_reliability: repeat-measurement IDs corresponding to the predictor values
replicate counts and within-source measurement variance tied to each reconstructed mean
a source-native reliability/repeatability estimate on the flower-area predictor scale
not_valid_reliability_substitutes: between-source spread without a defined repeated-measurement model

next_search_targets: Southwest Pacific 30-species paired online-vs-herbarium validation values
supplementary or repository material containing repeated floral measurements or predictor-scale measurement error
Hendriks thesis/source appendices or cited primary measurements with repeat information
claim_boundary: The present source-native files do not identify empirical predictor reliability. This result forbids substituting an assumed reliability for an observed one, but it does not prove that no suitable external validation source can be recovered.
